title: Mercedes Actros FUPS compliant polished Aluminium custom built Bullbar #6
description: Mercedes Actros 2658 Wild Bar Low-Line Design FUPS hi-tensile aluminium Bullbar with custom built heavy duty 6mm wall high tensile aluminium internal box uprights and heavy duty high tensile flat bar external uprights. Designed using heavy wall rectangular hollow section bars and custom designed outer reinforced 6mm wall high tensile pipes to give maximum protection. Mounted using a high tensile aluminium backing plate. Custom built heavy duty main lower channel to suit factory fitted radar. Driving light mounts on the outside of the uprights on the top bar. This design gives maximum protection to your investment with low mount design.
